parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states that the authors did not give detailed information about the dataset and asks specific questions about sources, collection methods, and dataset release. Per the criteria, clarification questions are treated as explicit statements when they give a direct action, and these three questions directly identify what the authors must address. The questions are also concrete: they specify exactly which information items the authors need to provide (dataset sources, collection methods, and release plan), so the authors know precisely what needs to be done and how to apply it. Therefore, the comment contains both explicit actions and concrete details on implementing them, which corresponds to the highest level of the rubric.
